# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

# Required Packages

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dada2)
library(microseq)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Global Settings

```{r}
setwd("/path/to/working/directory") # Path to your working directory
```

## Prepare directories

```{r}
path                          <- "1000_species_10_dynamic"         # Define dataset to process
fastq.folder                  <- file.path(path, "fastq")          # Directory containing the raw FASTQ files
fastq_filt.folder             <- file.path(path, "fastq_filtered") # Directory containing quality-filtered FASTQ files
dada2_dir                     <- file.path(path, "dada2_results")  # Directory containing DADA2 output
metadata.file                 <- file.path(path, "metadata.tsv")   # Path to the metadata file
dominant_species_folder_dada2 <- 
  file.path(dada2_dir, "dominant_species")                         # Directory containing dominant-species assignments for each cluster
abundance_folder_dada2        <- 
  file.path(dada2_dir, "abundance_tables")             # Directory containing observed and ground truth abundance tables
error_obj.folder              <- 
  file.path(dada2_dir, "error_objects")                # Directory containing DADA2 error objects
centroids.folder              <- 
  file.path(dada2_dir, "centroids")                    # Directory containing centroid FASTA files

# ----------------------------
# Create required directories
# ----------------------------

if (!dir.exists(dada2_dir)) {
  dir.create(dada2_dir)
}

if (!dir.exists(dominant_species_folder_dada2)) {
  dir.create(dominant_species_folder_dada2)
}

if (!dir.exists(abundance_folder_dada2)) {
  dir.create(abundance_folder_dada2)
}

if (!dir.exists(error_obj.folder)) {
  dir.create(error_obj.folder)
}

if (!dir.exists(centroids.folder)) {
  dir.create(centroids.folder)
}
```

## Metadata

```{r}
# Read metadata file and add columns for results
metadata.tbl <- read_tsv(metadata.file) %>% 
  select(-c(community_id, amplicon_file)) %>%
  rename(n_reads = readpairs) %>% 
  mutate(dataset = path) %>%
  mutate(n_reads_filtered = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_reads_merged = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_reads_wo_chimera = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_clusters = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_pure_clusters = 0) %>%
  mutate(n_perfect_clusters = 0) %>%
  mutate(average_purity_score = 0) %>%
  mutate(n_species = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_species_filtered = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_species_merged = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_species_wo_chimera = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_species_represented = 0) %>% 
  mutate(n_species_with_multiple_clusters = 0) %>% 
  mutate(abundance_correlation = 0)
```

# Collect Metadata

## Raw Reads

```{r}
R1_files <- file.path(fastq.folder, paste0(metadata.tbl$sample_id, "_R1.fastq.gz"))

for(i in 1:length(R1_files)){
  fq1 <- readFastq(R1_files[i]) %>% 
    mutate(species = Header %>% 
             str_extract("(?<=s:).+?(?=_\\d+_\\d+/)"))
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species[i] <- n_distinct(fq1$species)
} # Record the number of species present before read processing in the raw files in each sample

save(metadata.tbl, file = file.path(dada2_dir, "metadata.tbl.RData")) # Save metadata
```

## Filtered Reads

```{r}
filt_R1_files <- file.path(fastq_filt.folder, paste0(metadata.tbl$sample_id, "_R1_filtered.fastq"))
filt_R2_files <- file.path(fastq_filt.folder, paste0(metadata.tbl$sample_id, "_R2_filtered.fastq"))

for(i in 1:length(filt_R1_files)){
  fq1 <- readFastq(filt_R1_files[i])
  metadata.tbl$n_reads_filtered[i] <- nrow(fq1)
  
  fq1 <- fq1 %>% 
    mutate(species = Header %>% 
             str_extract("(?<=s:).+?(?=_\\d+_\\d+/)"))
  metadata.tbl$n_species_filtered[i] <- n_distinct(fq1$species)
} # Record the number of species represented after quality filtering

save(metadata.tbl, file = file.path(dada2_dir, "metadata.tbl.RData")) # Save metadata
```

# DADA2 Denoising Pipeline with Read-Level Tracking

```{r}
for (i in 1:nrow(metadata.tbl)) { # Iterate over each sample in the metadata table
  
  message(paste0("Processing sample ", 
                 metadata.tbl$sample_id[i], 
                 " (", i, "/", nrow(metadata.tbl), ")"))
  
  # ------------------
  # Learn error models
  # ------------------
  
  err.obj_R1 <- 
    learnErrors(fls = filt_R1_files[i],
                multithread = TRUE,
                verbose= TRUE) # Learn the sample-specific error model for forward (R1) reads
  
  save(err.obj_R1, file = file.path(error_obj.folder,
                                    paste0(str_remove(basename(filt_R1_files[i]),
                                                      "R1_filtered.fastq"),
                                           "err.obj_R1.RData"))) # Save the forward-read error model for later reuse
  
  err.obj_R2 <- 
    learnErrors(fls = filt_R2_files[i],
                multithread = TRUE,
                verbose= TRUE) # Learn the sample-specific error model for reverse (R2) reads
  
  save(err.obj_R2, file = file.path(error_obj.folder,
                                    paste0(str_remove(basename(filt_R2_files[i]),
                                                      "R2_filtered.fastq"),
                                           "err.obj_R2.RData"))) # Save the reverse-read error model for later reuse
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Dereplication and denoising
  # ---------------------------
  
  derepF <- 
    derepFastq(
      filt_R1_files[i], verbose = FALSE) # Dereplicate filtered forward reads while retaining the mapping from reads to unique sequences
  
  derepR <- 
    derepFastq(
      filt_R2_files[i], verbose = FALSE) # Dereplicate filtered reverse reads while retaining the mapping from reads to unique sequences
  
  dadaF <- dada(
    derepF, err = err.obj_R1, multithread = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) # Denoise forward reads using the learned R1 error model
  
  dadaR <- dada(
    derepR, err = err.obj_R2, multithread = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) # Denoise reverse reads using the learned R2 error model
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Merge paired-end sequences
  # ---------------------------
  
  merged.obj <- mergePairs(dadaF, derepF, dadaR, derepR, verbose = FALSE) # Merge denoised forward and reverse sequences
  
  # ----------------
  # Remove chimeras
  # ----------------
  
  merged_wo_chimera.obj <- removeBimeraDenovo(
    merged.obj,
    method = "consensus",
    multithread = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE) # Identify and remove chimeric merged sequences
  
  # ---------------------
  # Create sequence table
  # ---------------------
  
  seqtab.local <- makeSequenceTable(merged_wo_chimera.obj) # Create an ASV abundance table from the chimera-free merged sequences
  
  local_valid_sequences <- colnames(seqtab.local) # Extract nucleotide sequences corresponding to retained ASVs
  
  # --------------------------
  # Prepare read-level tracking
  # --------------------------
  
  headers_R1 <- readFastq(filt_R1_files[i])$Header # Retrieve original read headers from the filtered forward FASTQ file
  
  df <- as.data.frame(headers_R1) %>%
    rename(Header = headers_R1) %>%
    mutate(species = Header %>% 
             str_extract("(?<=s:).+?(?=_\\d+_\\d+/)")) # Extract the ground truth species identity from each read header
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species[i] <- length(unique(df$species)) # Record the number of ground truth species represented in the filtered reads
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Map original reads to denoised sequences
  # -----------------------------------------
  
  read_to_denoised_F_index <- dadaF$map[derepF$map] # Map each original forward read to its corresponding denoised sequence
  
  read_to_denoised_R_index <- dadaR$map[derepR$map] # Map each original reverse read to its corresponding denoised sequence
  
  # --------------------------------
  # Map denoised reads to merged ASVs
  # --------------------------------
  
  read_pair_key <- paste(read_to_denoised_F_index, read_to_denoised_R_index, sep = "_") # Create a forward-reverse denoised-sequence key for each original read pair
  
  merged_key <- paste(merged.obj$forward, merged.obj$reverse, sep = "_") # Create the corresponding forward-reverse key for merged sequences
  
  match_idx <- match(read_pair_key, merged_key) # Identify the merged sequence associated with each original read pair
  
  assigned_sequences <- merged.obj$sequence[match_idx] # Retrieve the merged nucleotide sequence for each read pair; NA indicates failed merging
  
  # -------------------------------
  # Construct read-tracking table
  # -------------------------------
  
  dataset_tracking <- tibble(
    Dataset_ID = metadata.tbl$sample_id[i],
    Header = headers_R1,
    Merged_Sequence = assigned_sequences
  ) %>%
    mutate(ASV_Index =
             match(Merged_Sequence,
                   local_valid_sequences)) %>%      # Check if merged sequence is chimera-free
    mutate(ASV_ID =
             ifelse(is.na(ASV_Index),
                    NA,
                    paste0("OTU_", ASV_Index))) %>% # Assign cluster ID (If match is NA (chimera or merge fail), ID is NA)
    mutate(Status = case_when(                      # Add status flag
      is.na(Merged_Sequence) ~ "Merge_Failed",
      is.na(ASV_ID) ~ "Chimera",
      TRUE ~ "Valid_ASV"
    ))
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Collect DADA2 statistics
  # ---------------------------
  
  metadata.tbl$n_reads_merged[i] <- 
    sum(merged.obj$abundance) # Record the number of read pairs successfully merged
  
  metadata.tbl$n_reads_wo_chimera[i] <- 
    sum(merged_wo_chimera.obj$abundance) # Record the number of reads retained after chimera removal
  
  metadata.tbl$n_clusters[i] <- 
    ncol(seqtab.local) # Record the number of ASVs retained after chimera removal
  
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Write representative sequences
  # ----------------------------
  
  readcount.mat <- makeSequenceTable(merged_wo_chimera.obj)
  
  centroids.tbl <- tibble(Header = str_c("OTU", 1:ncol(readcount.mat)),
                          Sequence = colnames(readcount.mat)) # Create a FASTA-compatible table containing representative ASV sequences
  
  writeFasta(
    centroids.tbl, out.file = file.path(
      centroids.folder,
      paste0(str_remove(basename(filt_R1_files[i]),
                        "R1_filtered.fastq"),
             "centroids.fasta"))) # Write representative ASV sequences to FASTA for downstream analyses
  
  # ---------------
  # Purity analysis
  # ---------------
  
  dataset_tracking_proc <- dataset_tracking %>%
    mutate(predicted_cluster = ASV_ID) %>%
    mutate(actual_cluster = Header %>% 
             str_extract("(?<=s:).+?(?=_\\d+_\\d+/)")) # Add predicted ASV assignments and ground truth species identities to each read
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species_merged[i] <-
    dataset_tracking_proc %>%
    filter(!is.na(Merged_Sequence)) %>%
    pull(actual_cluster) %>%
    n_distinct() # Record the number of species represented among successfully merged reads
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species_wo_chimera[i] <-
    dataset_tracking_proc %>%
    filter(Status == "Valid_ASV") %>%
    pull(actual_cluster) %>%
    n_distinct() # Record the number of species represented after chimera removal
  
  
  cluster_summary <-
    dataset_tracking_proc %>%
    group_by(predicted_cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sequences = n(),               # Count the number of reads assigned to each predicted ASV
      distinct_actual_clusters = 
        n_distinct(actual_cluster),    # Count the number of distinct ground truth species represented within each ASV
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(                            # Add new column indicating if cluster is pure or mixed
      status = ifelse(
        distinct_actual_clusters == 1,
        "Pure",
        "Mixed")) %>%                  # Classify ASVs as pure (single species) or mixed (multiple species)
    arrange(status, desc(n_sequences)) # Sort by purity status and descending read count
  
  metadata.tbl$n_pure_clusters[i] <- 
    sum(cluster_summary$status == "Pure") # Record the number of pure predicted ASVs
  
  purity_summary <- dataset_tracking_proc %>%
    group_by(predicted_cluster) %>%
    dplyr::count(actual_cluster,
                 sort = TRUE,
                 name = "number"    
    ) %>%                                         # Count reads from each ground truth species within each predicted ASV
    summarise(
      total_number = sum(number),                 # Total number of reads assigned to the predicted ASV
      dominant_actual = first(actual_cluster),    # Ground truth species contributing the largest number of reads
      dominant_number = first(number),            # Number of reads contributed by the dominant species
      purity_pct = dominant_number / total_number # ASV purity: proportion of reads belonging to the dominant species
    ) %>%
    arrange(purity_pct)
  
  metadata.tbl$average_purity_score[i] <- 
    mean(purity_summary$purity_pct) # Calculate mean purity across predicted ASVs
  
  # -------------------------
  # Perfect clusters analysis
  #--------------------------
  
  dt <- dataset_tracking_proc # Alias for readability in the perfect-cluster analysis
  
  pure_asvs <- dt %>%
    filter(Status == "Valid_ASV", !is.na(predicted_cluster)) %>%
    group_by(predicted_cluster) %>%
    summarise(n_species = n_distinct(actual_cluster), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_species == 1) %>%
    select(predicted_cluster) # Identify ASVs containing reads from exactly one ground truth species
  
  dt_pure_valid <- dt %>%
    filter(Status == "Valid_ASV", !is.na(predicted_cluster)) %>%
    semi_join(pure_asvs, by = "predicted_cluster") # Retain reads belonging to pure ASVs
  
  species_ok <- dt_pure_valid %>%
    distinct(actual_cluster, predicted_cluster) %>%
    group_by(actual_cluster) %>%
    summarise(n_asv = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_asv == 1) %>%
    select(actual_cluster) # Retain species represented by exactly one pure ASV
  
  species_to_asv <- dt_pure_valid %>%
    semi_join(species_ok, by = "actual_cluster") %>%
    distinct(actual_cluster, predicted_cluster) # Establish the expected one-to-one mapping between species and ASVs
  
  violations <- dt %>%
    semi_join(species_ok, by = "actual_cluster") %>%
    left_join(
      species_to_asv, by = "actual_cluster", suffix = c("", "_expected")) %>%
    mutate(
      ok = (Status == "Valid_ASV") & (predicted_cluster == predicted_cluster_expected)) %>%
    filter(!ok) %>%
    select(actual_cluster, predicted_cluster_expected, 
           Header, Status, predicted_cluster) # Identify reads from candidate species that were lost or assigned outside the expected ASV
  
  missing_counts <- violations %>%
    group_by(predicted_cluster_expected) %>%
    summarise(n_missing = n(), .groups = "drop") # Count missing or incorrectly assigned reads for each candidate perfect ASV
  
  perfect_clusters_dada2 <- species_to_asv %>%
    left_join(missing_counts, by = c("predicted_cluster" = "predicted_cluster_expected")) %>%
    mutate(n_missing = coalesce(n_missing, 0L)) %>%
    filter(n_missing == 0) # Retain ASVs that are pure, non-split, and contain all reads from the corresponding species
  
  metadata.tbl$n_perfect_clusters[i] <- nrow(perfect_clusters_dada2) # Record the number of perfect ASVs
  
  # ------------------------------------------
  # Represented species and abundance profiles
  #-------------------------------------------
  
  df <- dataset_tracking_proc %>%
    filter(Status == "Valid_ASV") # Retain only reads assigned to valid ASVs
  
  dominant_species_per_cluster <- df %>%
    group_by(predicted_cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      species = {
        tab <- sort(table(actual_cluster), decreasing = TRUE)
        names(tab)[1]
      },
      .groups = "drop") # Assign each ASV to the ground truth species contributing the largest number of reads
  
  saveRDS(dominant_species_per_cluster,
          file = file.path(
            dominant_species_folder_dada2,
            paste0("dominant_species_per_cluster_", metadata.tbl$sample_id[i], ".rds"))) # Save dominant-species assignments for downstream analyses
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species_represented[i] <- 
    length(unique(dominant_species_per_cluster$species)) # Record the number of species represented by at least one ASV
  
  n_species_with_multiple_clusters <- dominant_species_per_cluster %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(n_clusters = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_clusters >= 2) %>%
    nrow() # Count species represented by multiple ASVs (over-splitting)
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species_with_multiple_clusters[i] <- 
    n_species_with_multiple_clusters # Record the number of over-split species
  
  # ------------------
  # Abundance analysis
  # ------------------
  
  fq <- readFastq(file.path(fastq.folder, metadata.tbl$R1_file[i])) %>%
    mutate(species = Header %>% 
             str_extract("(?<=s:).+?(?=_\\d+_\\d+/)")) # Read raw R1 reads and extract the ground truth species identity
  
  abundance_per_initiate_species <- fq %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(gold_standard_n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(gold_standard_rel_abundance = gold_standard_n / sum(gold_standard_n)) %>%
    arrange(desc(gold_standard_rel_abundance)) # Calculate ground truth relative abundance directly from raw read counts
  
  abundance_per_dominant_species <- df %>%
    left_join(dominant_species_per_cluster, by = "predicted_cluster") %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(rel_abundance = n / sum(n)) %>%
    arrange(desc(rel_abundance)) # Calculate observed species abundance after assigning each ASV to its dominant species
  
  abundance.tbl <- abundance_per_initiate_species %>%
    left_join(abundance_per_dominant_species, by = "species") %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0),
           rel_abundance = replace_na(rel_abundance, 0)) # Combine ground truth and observed abundance profiles and assign zero to missing species
  
  saveRDS(abundance.tbl,
          file = file.path(
            abundance_folder_dada2,
            paste0("abundance_", metadata.tbl$sample_id[i], ".rds"))) # Save abundance profiles for downstream comparisons
  
  metadata.tbl$abundance_correlation[i] <- cor(
    abundance.tbl$gold_standard_rel_abundance,
    abundance.tbl$rel_abundance) # Calculate Pearson correlation between ground truth and observed relative abundances
  
  # ---------------------------------
  # Non-clustered sequence statistics
  # ---------------------------------
  
  nc.tbl <- dataset_tracking %>% 
    filter(Status != "Valid_ASV") %>%                                   # Retain reads removed because of failed merging or chimera detection
    select(Dataset_ID, Header, Status) %>% 
    mutate(taxonomy = 
             str_match(Header, "tax=(.*)_[0-9]+_[0-9]+/[0-9]")[,2]) %>% # Extract the ground truth taxonomic label from each non-clustered read
    mutate(species = str_extract(taxonomy, "(?<=s:).*")) %>%            # Extract the species name from the taxonomic annotation
    left_join(abundance_per_initiate_species, by = "species")           # Attach ground truth abundance information
  
 metadata.tbl$n_reads_not_clustered[i] <- 
    nrow(nc.tbl) # Record the number of reads not represented by a valid ASV
  
  metadata.tbl$n_species_not_clustered[i] <- 
    n_distinct(nc.tbl$taxonomy) # Record the number of species represented among non-clustered reads
  
  metadata.tbl$median_ground_truth_abuandance[i] <- 
    median(nc.tbl$gold_standard_rel_abundance) # Record the median ground truth abundance of species contributing non-clustered reads
}

save(metadata.tbl, file = file.path(dada2_dir, "metadata.tbl.RData")) # Save metadata
```
# Plotting Preparations After Processing All Datasets

```{r}
# IMPORTANT:
# Run this section only after all datasets have been fully processed with the
# DADA2 pipeline. The code below loads the final metadata table from each
# dataset and combines them into a single table for downstream plotting and
# comparative analyses.

# --------------------------------
# Load per-dataset metadata tables
# --------------------------------

load("100_species_10_dynamic/dada2_results/metadata.tbl.RData")
metadata_100s_10d.tbl <- metadata.tbl                                        

load("100_species_100_dynamic/dada2_results/metadata.tbl.RData")
metadata_100s_100d.tbl <- metadata.tbl                                        

load("1000_species_10_dynamic/dada2_results/metadata.tbl.RData")
metadata_1000s_10d.tbl <- metadata.tbl                                       

load("1000_species_100_dynamic/dada2_results/metadata.tbl.RData")
metadata_1000s_100d.tbl <- metadata.tbl                                    

load("10000_species_10_dynamic/dada2_results/metadata.tbl.RData")
metadata_10000s_10d.tbl <- metadata.tbl                                        

load("10000_species_100_dynamic/dada2_results/metadata.tbl.RData")
metadata_10000s_100d.tbl <- metadata.tbl                                      

# --------------------------------------------
# Combine datasets by simulated species richness
# --------------------------------------------

metadata_100s <- bind_rows(
  metadata_100s_10d.tbl,
  metadata_100s_100d.tbl) # Combine all 100-species datasets across dynamic ranges

metadata_1000s <- bind_rows(
  metadata_1000s_10d.tbl,
  metadata_1000s_100d.tbl) # Combine all 1000-species datasets across dynamic ranges

metadata_10000s <- bind_rows(
  metadata_10000s_10d.tbl,
  metadata_10000s_100d.tbl) # Combine all 10000-species datasets across dynamic ranges

# --------------------------------
# Combine all processed datasets
# --------------------------------

metadata_all_dada2.tbl <- bind_rows(
  metadata_100s,
  metadata_1000s,
  metadata_10000s
) %>%
  mutate(pipeline = "dada2") # Add a pipeline identifier for downstream comparisons across methods

save(
  metadata_all_dada2.tbl,
  file = "metadata_all_dada2_tbl.RData") # Save the combined metadata table for downstream plotting and comparative analyses
```
